title: The ISO 27001:2022 transition deadline has passed
angle: The deadline is behind us, so this is no longer a planning topic. Anyone still on the 2013 certificate is uncertified, and the restructure is worth understanding on its own terms.
keyPoints: The transition deadline was 31 October 2025. A 2013 certificate that was not transitioned is no longer valid.
Annex A went from 114 controls across 14 domains to 93 controls across four themes: organisational, people, physical, technological.
Eleven controls are entirely new, and 57 were merged into 24.
Every remaining control got updated language.
A recurring implementation complaint: teams buy the standard without ISO 27002, then struggle because Annex A descriptions are high level and leave a lot open to interpretation.

sources.title: ISO 27001:2022 Transition: What You Need to Know
